_readme: HALF MOON BAY'S BEACH BREAK -- the Mavericks scene turned to the beach (2026-10-19). The bay
south-east of Pillar Point is in the point's lee from the WNW groundswell that fires the reef
(the swell march says so, and it is true of the place: the inner bay is calm when Mavericks is
breaking), so this scene brings the same swell from 245, the WSW, straight into the bay: Hs 3 m,
Tp 14 s, a sand bar in 2-5 m of water 100-300 m out, the 10 m line 600 m out -- a beach break.
The solved field spans the beach (4.2 x 3.5 km at 2.5 m); the eyes stand on the sand and over
the bar. Everything else is scenes/demos/mavericks.json's.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/mavericks_beach.json

views.name: beach
views._at: on the sand, 5 m up, looking WSW into the swell breaking on the bar

views.name: bar
views._at: 12 m over the inner bar, 250 m out, looking SW along the breaking line

views.name: beach_high
views._at: 60 m over the beach break, looking SW along the bar
